brief: Founder distribution: how I turn 1 carousel into 12 assets across 4 platforms — automated.

slots.body: I turn a single PDF into a month of content across every major platform without extra headcount.

slots.title: Start with
slots.body: Design one high-density carousel in Canva. This single PDF becomes raw material for every other asset in your system.

slots.title: LinkedIn gets
slots.body: Post the native carousel, strip text into a document, and pull the hook into a text update. One idea, three touchpoints.

slots.title: X gets
slots.body: Break the slides into a thread, turn key frames into single-image tweets, and repurpose quotes as standalone posts. Same story, different speed.

slots.title: Instagram sees
slots.body: Upload the carousel as-is, break highlights into a story sequence, and read the slides aloud for a reel. Visual repetition builds recognition.

slots.title: Video becomes
slots.body: Screen-record the carousel for a YouTube Short, crop vertically for TikTok, and use the audio for a podcast graphic. Text fuels video.

slots.title: Automation runs
slots.body: Use Make or Zapier to trigger exports, captions, and scheduling. The entire pipeline runs in under thirty minutes while you sleep.
Save this carousel and build your own automated repurposing engine this weekend. One input, twelve outputs, zero overwhelm.
